providers.name: GF Rewards
providers.operator: 株式会社フクロウラボ
providers.reviewNote: Official GF Rewards privacy information states that CookieID is automatically acquired to identify users who satisfy reward conditions. POIGAME LAB therefore records only first-party-observed provider presence and does not fetch provider offerwall URLs.

providers.name: AppDriver
providers.reviewNote: The publicly accessible AppDriver web offerwall integration guide shows request URLs carrying identifier (UserID), media_id and digest. Because the production offerwall is therefore not treated as an anonymous catalog, POIGAME LAB records passive provider presence only and does not request offerwall URLs.

providers.name: SKYFLAG
providers.reviewNote: Current official materials describe SKYFLAG offerwalls, API integration, user-segment optimization and recommended rewards, but do not establish an anonymous public campaign catalog suitable for unattended evidence retrieval. POIGAME LAB therefore records passive provider presence only.

providers.name: MyChips
providers.reviewNote: Official MyChips WebView/direct-link documentation requires content_id, user_id and webview parameters and recommends GAID/IDFA. POIGAME LAB therefore maps passive provider presence only and does not request the discovered offerwall endpoint.

providers.name: Zucks
providers.reviewNote: Official Zucks support documentation gives an offerwall inquiry URL example on ow.z.mobu.jp containing user_id. POIGAME LAB therefore treats the offerwall as user-contextual presence only.

providers.name: GMO SmaAD
providers.reviewNote: Official SmaAD materials describe SmaAD Wall as a dedicated offer list integrated into partner websites/apps and SDK-supported surfaces. No anonymous public campaign catalog suitable for unattended evidence retrieval was established.

providers.name: TyrAds
providers.reviewNote: Official TyrAds SDK documentation shows offerwall initialization with publisher credentials and CUSTOMER_USER_ID, and other SDK docs describe device/user identifiers. POIGAME LAB therefore records passive provider presence only.

providers.name: Playtime by adjoe
providers.reviewNote: Official PlaytimeWeb integration documentation requires user_id in the PlaytimeWeb redirect URL and recommends IDFA for attribution. POIGAME LAB therefore records only passive provider presence.

providers.name: ayeT
providers.reviewNote: Official ayeT Web Offerwall documentation requires externalIdentifier in the offerwall URL. POIGAME LAB therefore maps passive provider presence only and does not request the offerwall.
